title: A Wierdcore edit that feels familiar
content: I stumbled across this edit on a wierdcore account. I swear I've dreamt of this hallway in a house with the same peach colored walls. That part of the Mallworld myself and others have mentioned, where one will seem to have "spawned in" to someone's house late at night or early morning. There's one one home or awake yet but it feels like you accidentally stumbled into a strangers' house.
